$comment: The declared deployment topology, and the input to AD-10's boundary guard in
core/security/dual-llm-boundary.test.ts. It is tracked config, not documentation:
changing it changes what the test suite permits.
AD-10 requires the extraction model and the reasoning model to be a credential and
deploy-unit boundary — different credential, different deploy unit. The second clause
had nothing in this repository to read, which is why this file exists. A guard over an
absent file passes for the wrong reason.
Amended 2026-08-10: reasoning moved from claude-sonnet-5 to gemini-3.6-flash, so both
sides are Google and AD-10's vendor clause was withdrawn. Both origins below now name
one host, deliberately. What stops the sides merging is the credential separation and
the deploy-unit separation, which this file declares and the guard enforces.
GEMINI_OCR_MODEL was removed from the web unit's credentials on 2026-08-11: it is a
model identifier, not a secret. The boundary guard reads this array as the set of
secrets a unit holds, so a configuration value listed here weakens what the array
means and distorts any check reasoning about which unit holds which credential.
The reasoning unit is declared before it is built. That is deliberate: writing the
guard now is what makes epic 2 edit a tracked file, in a commit someone reviews, if it
ever wants to put both sides in one place.
